title: pi's cloudflare-workers-ai provider bypasses the gateway: it needs CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and never reads WORKERS_AI_BASE_URL
body: The installed @earendil-works/pi-ai hard-codes https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/v1 for cloudflare-workers-ai and throws if CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is unset; nothing reads WORKERS_AI_BASE_URL. mdw's boot exports only CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY=<run gateway token>, so a pi worker either fails at its first call or sends the run token to Cloudflare's API directly instead of the metered gateway. Needs a pi models.json/provider override pointing at $gateway/workers-ai (or the gateway's compat route) and a live probe, not an export-only test.
